description: Poll a workflow run by run_id, waiting up to wait_seconds (≤ 30) for it to end. Completed → the final output; failed / cancelled → the error; still running → its steps so far: call check_workflow_run again. No key needed: the run_id is the access token.

run_id.description: The run id returned by run_workflow (`wf:…`).

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for it to finish (0–30, default 30); 0 answers the current state at once.

name: check_workflow_run
title: Check a workflow run
